criteria.requirement: Check applicability before reusing an old verified finding.
criteria.pass_when: Identifies the current implementation differs from the supplied reviewed hash, runs the required gate and observes the invalid-command selection regression; treats R1 or equivalent affected invariant as needing correction/recheck. Old ready review remains historical.
criteria.fail_when: Calls R1 currently resolved/verified from the old review, suppresses the failing test or claims current checks pass. Product edits are outside this assessment scope.

criteria.requirement: Record the current blocker and next action without losing historical evidence.
criteria.pass_when: Current handoff distinguishes original verified candidate from changed code, gives concrete expected/actual state and pending correction/recheck plus human acceptance. Preserves originals without duplicating a verification framework.
criteria.fail_when: Unclear next action, author-only/static claim presented as independent approval, human acceptance inferred, or new machinery obscures the simple current blocker.
